sessionStart.bash: f="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/scripts/session-start.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then node "$f"; else cat >/dev/null; fi
sessionStart.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; $f = Join-Path "$r" "hooks/scripts/session-start.js"; if ($r -and (Test-Path $f)) { $input | node $f } else { $null = $input | Out-String }
